study: NREL Jones 2013 - Fast pyrolysis & hydrotreating bio-oil to hydrocarbon fuels TEA
their_baseline: 1st & 2nd stage reactor pressure and space velocity per base design
their_range: reduce pressure to 1200 psi + double 2nd-stage LHSV -> -7% reactor cost
range_justification: Range set by alternative reactor design conditions (wall thickness from T/P, capacity from LHSV); no citation.
quote: Reducing the first and second stage reactors pressure to 1200 psi and doubling the space velocity for the second stage results in a 7% reduction in the reactor costs and also reduces compression requirements.

study: NREL Jones 2013 - Fast pyrolysis & hydrotreating bio-oil to hydrocarbon fuels TEA
